title: Michael Leyva slams podcast hosts for mocking Kris Aquino’s son Josh
summary: Fashion designer Michael Leyva, a close family friend of the Aquinos, called out the hosts of podcast Machong Chismisan for making fun of Kris Aquino’s son, Josh, who is on the autism spectrum.…

blocks.text: Fashion designer Michael Leyva, a close family friend of the Aquinos, called out the hosts of podcast Machong Chismisan for making fun of Kris Aquino’s son, Josh, who is on the autism spectrum. The podcast episode has since been taken down from the group’s page, but clips of it were already reposted by several netizens on social media. “Si Bimby sobrang okay na anak. Si Josh walang kwenta e. Naka-gano’n lang oh,” Tito P, one of the five male hosts, said while laughing. Another host even remarked, “Guys, kino-call out namin si Tito P.
